newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end little changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end little changed in thin trade.

text.p: After seesawing sharply during the week, Brazilian stocks ended little changed on Friday in sluggish trade amid an absence of fresh market-moving news, brokers said.
The Sao Paulo bolsa's Bovespa index of the 47 most active stocks ended off 0.01 percent at 12,523 points.

Total market turnover was 482 million reais ($446.2 million), well below the bolsa's recent daily average of over one billion reais. Financial volume for the shares in the Bovespa index portfolio was 364.3 million reais ($337.3 million).
